abstract.p: The BAREC 2025 Shared Task on Arabic readability targets 19 levels of ordinal prediction at the sentence and document levels under strict training. This paper describes a two stages system that basically starts with BAREC-tuned AraBERT checkpoints and then specializes on the Strict splits with Weighted Kappa Loss (WKL), an objective aligned with Quadratic Weighted Kappa (QWK). A single architecture with inputs specific to each track is utilized for both tracks. On the Strict setting, our best systems reach 0.842/0.841 QWK (public/blind) at the sentence level and 0.828/0.790 QWK at the document level.
